title: Airframe roughness breakup
change: Add a restrained roughness-only microvariation to the existing Yak airframe material using an imported grayscale dirt mask.
implementation_notes: Blend the mask at low contrast into roughness only; keep base color and lighting response unchanged.
capture_safe_reason: Uses existing airframe materials, preserves the unlit HF value structure, and avoids darkening the FOV.
acceptance_test: All 11 cameras remain usable; YakBeauty and PropNose show visible but subtle roughness variation without new black patches.

title: Airframe normal grain
change: Introduce a very low-strength normal-map grain on the exposed airframe panels.
implementation_notes: Use a tiling imported metal normal at minimal intensity and clamp the result so panel silhouettes remain unchanged.
capture_safe_reason: Only adds local surface frequency to the existing material and does not replace the frozen HF treatment.
acceptance_test: The airframe gains readable panel grain in Prop and YakBeauty while silhouette, exposure, and camera usability remain unchanged.

title: Airframe AO seam lift
change: Strengthen ambient-occlusion response only in existing airframe panel seams.
implementation_notes: Multiply the AO map into the existing shading at a restrained value; exclude broad surfaces and preserve midtone fill.
capture_safe_reason: Local seam contrast improves structure without applying a dark material across any camera-facing surface.
acceptance_test: Seams read more clearly at PropNose and Cockpit; no contiguous black region exceeds the existing seam width.

title: Airframe dirt gradient
change: Add a subtle directional dirt gradient to the lower airframe only.
implementation_notes: Use vertex position or existing UV orientation to confine dirt to undersides; keep opacity and contrast low.
capture_safe_reason: Confined lower-surface weathering avoids darkening the primary FOV and keeps the frozen silhouette intact.
acceptance_test: Lower panels gain readable grime variation in both views without visible broad washout or black collapse.

title: Airframe paint-to-metal transition
change: Add a narrow roughness transition along one existing painted-to-metal boundary.
implementation_notes: Use a single existing UV mask to sharpen one material transition; do not add geometry or a new dark stripe.
capture_safe_reason: The change is a thin roughness edge on existing material regions and does not compete with HF densify.
acceptance_test: The selected transition reads as a material boundary in PropNose and PropHub with no added silhouette or black band.

title: Prop disc translucent rim
change: Add a thin low-intensity emissive rim to the existing prop disc material.
implementation_notes: Use a narrow radial mask with low emissive strength and no additive fill across the disc center.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive emission improves disc separation without replacing the frozen unlit HF disc or washing the sky.
acceptance_test: Prop and PropHub show a readable disc perimeter; the center remains neutral and no camera loses usability.

title: Prop disc blade-phase tint
change: Apply a restrained alternating tint to the existing prop disc material keyed to blade-phase UV bands.
implementation_notes: Keep the tint close to the current disc value and limit it to two or three broad phase bands.
capture_safe_reason: Creates low-contrast phase readability inside the existing disc treatment without introducing dark metal or extra geometry.
acceptance_test: Blade phase is more legible at PropNose and YakBeauty while disc opacity and overall luminance remain stable.

title: Prop hub disc contrast ring
change: Add one narrow roughness contrast ring around the existing prop hub-to-disc junction.
implementation_notes: Modify roughness only with a soft radial mask; retain the current base-color values and avoid a black outline.
capture_safe_reason: A single localized material ring reinforces an existing junction and does not expand into other stage silhouettes.
acceptance_test: The hub-disc junction is clearly separated in PropHub with no visible black outline or usability regression.

title: Rifle tan value variation
change: Add small light-to-dark tan variation to the existing rifle body material.
implementation_notes: Use an imported grayscale mask for two restrained tan values; keep the overall rifle brighter than dark-metal reference values.
capture_safe_reason: Preserves the rifle's tan identity and increases local readability without introducing a dark sole-FOV material.
acceptance_test: ADS and Combat show separated tan rifle regions with no clipped dark patches and unchanged camera usability.

title: Rifle worn-metal highlight
change: Add a thin desaturated worn-metal highlight on one existing rifle wear path.
implementation_notes: Use extremely low additive intensity or view-stable sheen-like emission only on the pre-existing wear mask.
capture_safe_reason: The accent is small, additive, and localized to the rifle, so it cannot replace the cockpit HF pass or affect distant cameras.
acceptance_test: One worn rifle edge catches a restrained highlight in ADS without blooming, glare, or loss of tan readability.

title: Rifle receiver AO lift
change: Increase AO definition around the existing rifle receiver recesses while preserving tan fill.
implementation_notes: Apply the AO only to recess masks and clamp the minimum value so no recess becomes black.
capture_safe_reason: Improves close-range rifle structure using existing material channels and controlled AO rather than a dark replacement material.
acceptance_test: Receiver recesses separate in ADS and Combat while tan surfaces retain their current brightness.

title: Rifle magazine edge wear
change: Add a sparse low-contrast worn-metal mask to the magazine edge of the existing rifle material.
implementation_notes: Limit the effect to a single edge mask and blend toward a muted mid-gray, not chrome or near-black.
capture_safe_reason: A single controlled wear edge adds material storytelling without changing the rifle silhouette or FOV exposure.
acceptance_test: The magazine edge reads as worn metal in ADS with no specular spike or dark-material takeover.

title: Behind-wall rust fleck tile
change: Place a small rust-fleck material tile behind the wall on an existing occluded surface.
implementation_notes: Use one thin plane or existing tile mesh fully occluded until x>=bx+3; keep the texture midtone and low saturation.
capture_safe_reason: The rust accent is fully behind the wall and cannot enter the frozen FOV or interfere with City/Wide composition.
acceptance_test: The fleck tile is visible only in the intended behind-wall inspection position and all 11 cameras remain usable.

title: Behind-wall damp dirt tile
change: Add one small damp-dirt tile behind the wall using a restrained roughness and albedo variation.
implementation_notes: Constrain the tile to the occluded wall-back region and avoid glossy wetness or near-black albedo.
capture_safe_reason: The tile is a tiny behind-wall accent, with no front-facing material replacement or weathering spill into Ocean.
acceptance_test: Damp variation reads from the intended behind-wall view while Harbor and Ocean preserve existing sky and water values.

title: Behind-wall oxidized seam
change: Create one narrow oxidized seam on an existing wall-back metal strip.
implementation_notes: Modify roughness and a small amount of muted rust color on a single seam; keep the strip fully behind the wall.
capture_safe_reason: The seam is occluded at every frozen capture position and uses a narrow, midtone weathering mask.
acceptance_test: The seam appears only behind the wall and does not alter City, Wide, or any other camera's foreground material read.

title: Behind-wall dirt runoff stripe
change: Add one short vertical dirt-runoff stripe to an occluded wall-back panel.
implementation_notes: Use a sparse opacity mask with a soft termination; keep width narrow and avoid repeating bands.
capture_safe_reason: The weathering remains behind the wall and is too small to influence the frozen harbor silhouette or water contrast.
acceptance_test: Only the intended occluded inspection angle reveals the runoff stripe; Harbor remains usable at 11/11 capture positions.

title: Airframe edge oxidation tint
change: Apply a tiny muted oxidation tint to one existing airframe edge mask.
implementation_notes: Blend a warm gray-brown tint at low opacity and keep the affected edge shorter than the current panel accents.
capture_safe_reason: This is a tiny local existing-material adjustment, not a dark PBR replacement, and it preserves the HF densify in both views.
acceptance_test: The selected edge gains a subtle oxidized break without darkening adjacent panels or reducing either camera below usable.

title: Airframe dirt speckle suppression
change: Add sparse, midtone dirt speckles to the existing airframe material while explicitly excluding broad dark patches.
implementation_notes: Use a high-threshold sparse mask blended mainly into roughness and slightly into albedo; clamp albedo away from black.
capture_safe_reason: The mask is sparse, midtone, and channel-limited, protecting Wide and Prop from uniqueness or black collapse.
acceptance_test: Speckles are visible only at close enough range to add material breakup; Wide remains visually stable and usable.

title: Prop disc haze balance
change: Reduce the existing prop disc's center haze while preserving the frozen disc footprint.
implementation_notes: Use a soft center mask to slightly lower opacity or value in the haze core, leaving the current rim and HF phase treatment untouched.
capture_safe_reason: This is a small internal disc adjustment that improves readability without adding geometry, washout, or dark material.
acceptance_test: The disc center is less muddy and blade phase remains readable in Prop and PropNose with unchanged usability.

title: Behind-wall layered dirt patch
change: Add a single small layered rust-and-dirt patch behind the wall using existing imported texture channels.
implementation_notes: Keep the patch compact, desaturated, and fully occluded until x>=bx+3; use roughness variation as the primary signal.
capture_safe_reason: The asset is a tiny behind-wall material accent, so it cannot stack into a hero foreground change or disturb the 11/11 freeze.
acceptance_test: The patch reads as layered weathering only in the intended behind-wall position and all frozen cameras remain usable.

title: Yak wing-root seam ladder
change: Add three thin unlit HF seam strips and two short breakpoints across the Yak wing-root panel junction.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3, keep strips hairline-thin, use mid-light unlit values, and avoid continuous full-length lines.
capture_safe_reason: Localized authored geometry remains behind the wall and does not alter the frozen FOV shell.
acceptance_test: Run Loop52 and confirm 11/11 usable, visible wing-root breakup in YakBeauty, and no black-area increase in PropNose.

title: Fuselage inspection hatch rim
change: Add one shallow offset inspection-hatch rim with a deliberately interrupted lower edge on the fuselage.
implementation_notes: Use a small rectangular rim at x>=bx+3 with two missing corner segments; keep the base panel bright enough for unlit HF separation.
capture_safe_reason: A single small panel accent adds silhouette-adjacent structure without introducing dark PBR coverage.
acceptance_test: Verify hatch rim reads as a distinct local feature in YakBeauty while Prop remains usable and bright.

title: Tailplane hinge tabs
change: Add two small bright hinge-tab plates and one short hinge-line gap at the horizontal tailplane.
implementation_notes: Place the tabs at x>=bx+3, keep them asymmetrically spaced, and use thin light trim rather than dark recesses.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny rear-airframe accents stay isolated behind the wall and cannot dominate cockpit or prop FOV.
acceptance_test: Confirm the hinge tabs create two stable edge clusters in YakBeauty with unchanged 11/11 usability.

title: Cowling louver break pair
change: Add two short offset louver strips on the cowling with unequal spacing and a visible center gap.
implementation_notes: Keep each louver narrow and shallow at x>=bx+3; use bright-to-mid unlit contrast and no black cavity material.
capture_safe_reason: The proposal adds localized panel rhythm without expanding any dark region in the nose.
acceptance_test: Check two readable louver clusters in YakBeauty and no uniqueness or black collapse in PropNose.

title: Landing-gear fairing notch
change: Add one thin bright notch plate and a short offset seam to the landing-gear fairing.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3, keep the notch smaller than the existing panel accents, and preserve the bright HF shell underneath.
capture_safe_reason: A single fairing detail is depth-gated and does not add a broad material change.
acceptance_test: Run the frozen capture and confirm the notch reads locally without reducing PropNose usability.

title: Canopy frame edge glint
change: Add a narrow additive emissive proxy following only the upper-front canopy frame edge.
implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity warm-white line with soft falloff, leaving canopy glass transparent or bright HF; limit coverage to a short broken arc.
capture_safe_reason: The proxy is tiny, additive, and avoids dark glass or full-canopy coverage.
acceptance_test: Confirm the broken glint improves canopy edge separation without glass turning black in YakBeauty or Cockpit.

title: Canopy latch pin trio
change: Add three tiny additive emissive latch-pin dots along the side canopy frame.
implementation_notes: Use three discrete low-intensity dots with nonuniform spacing; do not darken or occlude the canopy surface.
capture_safe_reason: Discrete emissive points add scale cues while leaving the canopy base material unchanged.
acceptance_test: Verify all three pins are visible as separate cues in Cockpit and do not create a black-glass region.

title: Cockpit tub sidewall rib pair
change: Add two shallow, bright sidewall ribs inside the cockpit tub with a small gap between them.
implementation_notes: Place authored ribs at x>=bx+3, keep them thinner than the existing tub silhouette, and avoid dark cavity fill.
capture_safe_reason: The detail is localized to the cockpit tub and depth-gated behind the frozen HF layer.
acceptance_test: Confirm the ribs create readable sidewall breakup in Cockpit without reducing cockpit visibility or usability.

title: Instrument cluster separator tabs
change: Add four small bright separator tabs between adjacent instrument groupings in the instrument cluster.
implementation_notes: Use short tab geometry at x>=bx+3, with alternating lengths and no dark bezel replacement.
capture_safe_reason: Small bright tabs improve instrument grouping without covering dials or adding black material.
acceptance_test: Check distinct separators in Cockpit and ADS while all primary instrument faces remain readable.

title: Glare-shield broken lip
change: Add one thin broken lip along the front edge of the instrument glare shield.
implementation_notes: Build a short segmented bright trim at x>=bx+3; keep its height below the existing dashboard silhouette and avoid a continuous black overhang.
capture_safe_reason: The lip is a thin behind-wall edge cue that does not mask the instrument faces.
acceptance_test: Confirm the broken lip adds dashboard depth in both cockpit views without occlusion or usability loss.

title: Switch cap height variation
change: Replace three adjacent uniform switch caps with slightly varied bright unlit cap heights.
implementation_notes: Keep the three caps in the existing switch row, vary height by small increments, and preserve the current light material family.
capture_safe_reason: The change is a tiny local silhouette variation inside the existing bright cockpit cluster.
acceptance_test: Verify the three caps separate at cockpit capture resolution and no surrounding panel becomes darker.

title: Glove palm seam accent
change: Add one short additive emissive seam accent across the glove palm crease.
implementation_notes: Use a very low-intensity neutral highlight, limited to one broken palm seam, with no change to glove base color.
capture_safe_reason: A single tiny emissive seam adds hand readability without introducing a dark material or broad glow.
acceptance_test: Confirm the palm crease is visible in Cockpit and does not wash out nearby controls.

title: Glove cuff fold pair
change: Add two shallow bright fold strips at the glove-to-sleeve cuff transition.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3, keep folds short and offset, and avoid a black sleeve material or continuous contour line.
capture_safe_reason: The cuff detail is small, bright, and isolated to the existing arm silhouette.
acceptance_test: Verify two separate cuff folds read in Cockpit without changing hand pose or occluding the instrument panel.

title: Arm harness stitch markers
change: Add four tiny unlit HF stitch markers along the visible glove-arm harness edge.
implementation_notes: Use four separated short marks at x>=bx+3, alternate their orientation slightly, and keep them below single-pixel scale at wide views.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny stitch markers add authored specificity without affecting the broader cockpit value structure.
acceptance_test: Confirm markers remain subtle in Cockpit and disappear harmlessly at non-hero distances.

title: Cockpit floor pedal rails
change: Add two short bright rail edges beneath the visible pedal area in the cockpit tub.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3, use separated rails with a center break, and retain the existing floor brightness instead of adding a dark recess.
capture_safe_reason: The rails are low-profile cockpit-only accents and cannot affect exterior camera composition.
acceptance_test: Verify the pedal region gains two readable edge cues in Cockpit with no dark floor expansion.

title: Gunner station sight rail
change: Add one small bright sight-rail segment and one offset mounting lug at the gunner station.
implementation_notes: Place both pieces at x>=bx+3, keep the rail segment short, and use light unlit metal-tone values without dark PBR coverage.
capture_safe_reason: Two small depth-gated pieces provide station scale without creating a multi-stage hero stack.
acceptance_test: Confirm the rail and lug remain distinct in Cockpit and ADS while primary sight elements remain unobscured.

title: Prop hub bright shell ring
change: Add a thin bright unlit shell ring around the propeller hub collar.
implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity warm-neutral emissive ring with a narrow mask; preserve the existing bright hub and avoid darkening the spinner.
capture_safe_reason: The ring is a tiny additive highlight on an already bright shell and cannot create black collapse.
acceptance_test: Verify the hub collar separates cleanly in PropHub and PropNose with no clipped glow or usability drop.

title: Blade-root bright shell bands
change: Add one narrow bright shell band to each visible propeller blade root.
implementation_notes: Limit each band to the first short root section, use low-intensity neutral emissive, and keep the band width below the existing blade edge width.
capture_safe_reason: Short bright root bands reinforce blade separation without changing blade mass or introducing dark surfaces.
acceptance_test: Confirm blade-root bands remain thin and distinct in Prop and PropNose with stable brightness at motionless capture.

title: Spinner center-cap glint
change: Add one tiny additive emissive center-cap glint on the prop spinner.
implementation_notes: Use a small soft circular mask at low intensity, centered on the existing bright cap, with no change to spinner silhouette or base roughness.
capture_safe_reason: The glint is a sub-detail additive proxy on a bright surface and carries negligible coverage risk.
acceptance_test: Verify the center cap gains a controlled focal cue without clipping, bloom washout, or black-region growth.

title: Elevator hinge fastener pair
change: Add two small bright fastener heads flanking one elevator hinge break.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3, use two separated circular heads and one short hinge gap, keeping all values in the existing unlit HF range.
capture_safe_reason: The pair is a tiny behind-wall authored accent that adds aircraft specificity without broad shading changes.
acceptance_test: Confirm both fasteners and the hinge gap read in YakBeauty while Loop52 remains 11/11 usable.

title: Bright facade window rhythm
change: Add a thin, warm-white unlit window-band proxy to the apartment midrise facade, with varied lit-window spacing.
implementation_notes: Use a shallow additive plane offset from the facade; keep emissive intensity restrained and window coverage below 12 percent of visible facade area.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive bright detail avoids dark FOV materials and does not alter the frozen camera framing.
acceptance_test: Capture City and Wide; confirm window bands remain thin, readable, and do not produce sun-like bloom or reduce any camera below Usable.

title: Warm tower parapet caps
change: Add narrow pale-stone parapet cap strips along the top edges of facade towers.
implementation_notes: Place the authored cap geometry at x>=bx+3 and keep projection thickness minimal; use ivory plaster or light brick rather than metal.
capture_safe_reason: The cap is a tiny behind-wall silhouette accent using a bright non-metal material.
acceptance_test: Verify no cap crosses the frozen FOV boundary and confirm City/Wide retain clear skyline separation without washout.

title: Corrugated facade rib cadence
change: Add three bright corrugated vertical ribs to one apartment or industrial facade section.
implementation_notes: Use sparse, light-gray ribs with alternating roughness; keep the section behind wall at x>=bx+3 and avoid full-facade repetition.
capture_safe_reason: Localized behind-wall geometry adds bright vertical structure without introducing a dark sole FOV material.
acceptance_test: Capture City and check that ribs read as three separate facade edges without clipping, aliasing, or uniqueness collapse.

title: Facade drain downspout
change: Add one pale vertical drain downspout with two small elbows to a bright tower corner.
implementation_notes: Build as a narrow additive proxy with low luminance and a warm-gray tint; place only on a corner already visible in City.
capture_safe_reason: The detail is narrow, additive, and bright enough to avoid black breakup while remaining below the hero-detail scale.
acceptance_test: Confirm the downspout is readable at capture resolution and adds no large bloom streak or camera occlusion.

title: Bright facade color-block patch
change: Add one muted terracotta color-block panel to a distant coast block facade.
implementation_notes: Use a single low-contrast rectangular patch behind wall at x>=bx+3; keep albedo above mid-gray and avoid repeating it on multiple buildings.
capture_safe_reason: One small bright color cue improves facade separation without adding a hero stack or dark material.
acceptance_test: Verify the patch remains localized, does not dominate the skyline, and keeps City/Wide Usable.

title: Crane counterweight safety stripe
change: Add a small yellow-and-white safety stripe to the harbor crane counterweight.
implementation_notes: Apply a restrained additive stripe mask to the counterweight face; keep the stripe narrow and avoid red warning-light intensity.
capture_safe_reason: A small bright additive marking gives the crane a clear color anchor without changing silhouette or exposure.
acceptance_test: Capture Harbor and confirm stripe readability without bloom washout, silhouette loss, or reduced usability.

title: Crane cable sheave highlights
change: Add two small pale highlight rings to the visible crane cable sheaves.
implementation_notes: Use thin additive rings with low intensity and no animated spark behavior; limit the change to the two largest sheaves.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive rings improve circular feature recognition without introducing dark metal into the FOV.
acceptance_test: Confirm both rings remain subpixel-to-small at capture distance and do not create circular glare artifacts.

title: Container corner castings
change: Add four pale corner-casting blocks to one visible container stack.
implementation_notes: Use a single stack behind wall at x>=bx+3 with light painted-metal material; keep castings shallow and confined to container corners.
capture_safe_reason: Localized bright geometry adds industrial detail while remaining behind the capture wall and outside hero FOV risk.
acceptance_test: Verify castings improve container segmentation in Harbor/Wide without adding excessive edge density or clipping.

title: Ship hull waterline stripe
change: Add a thin desaturated teal waterline stripe to the container ship hull.
implementation_notes: Apply one narrow stripe below the main hull band, using a mid-bright teal that remains visibly lighter than the ocean.
capture_safe_reason: The stripe is a restrained behind-wall color separator and prevents the hull from merging into a dark ocean read.
acceptance_test: Capture Harbor and Ocean; confirm hull and water remain separable with no pure-black final ocean region.

title: Freighter deck hatch line
change: Add one short pale deck-hatch outline to the freighter stern.
implementation_notes: Use a small additive rectangular outline on the existing deck plane; keep luminance below signage brightness and avoid stacked hatch patterns.
capture_safe_reason: The single small additive outline improves deck readability without changing the ship silhouette.
acceptance_test: Confirm the hatch line is visible only as a small local accent and causes no glare or frame-wide exposure shift.

title: Pier bollard marker pair
change: Add two pale-yellow safety marker caps to the nearest pier bollards.
implementation_notes: Use small capped discs with low additive intensity; place them on two existing bollard positions and avoid adding new full bollard geometry.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny bright markers improve pier scale cues while keeping geometry and luminance tightly bounded.
acceptance_test: Verify both caps read as markers, not lights, and Harbor remains Usable with no bloom washout.

title: Pier deck plank highlight
change: Add three short alternating warm-gray highlight strips across a pier deck section.
implementation_notes: Keep strips thin, sparse, and behind wall at x>=bx+3; use rough warm-gray material with no glossy response.
capture_safe_reason: Sparse bright strips add local deck texture without dark PBR or large hero geometry.
acceptance_test: Confirm the strips do not form repetitive moire at capture resolution and do not alter Harbor usability.

title: Seawall capstone rhythm
change: Add five light concrete capstone seams along one seawall segment.
implementation_notes: Use shallow seam geometry or a masked unlit accent with even spacing; keep the seawall material light concrete and avoid deep black gaps.
capture_safe_reason: Light concrete segmentation strengthens the seawall silhouette and avoids dark ocean-adjacent collapse.
acceptance_test: Capture Harbor/Ocean and verify seams remain thin, non-black, and free of repeating alias patterns.

title: Seawall tide-level markers
change: Add two small cyan tide-level marker dashes to the seawall face.
implementation_notes: Place two short low-intensity dashes near the waterline; use cyan-green rather than white to preserve contrast with foam.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive marks introduce controlled color variation without affecting ocean exposure or silhouette.
acceptance_test: Confirm markers remain small, do not read as navigational lights, and preserve Ocean usability.

title: Foam lace shoreline edge
change: Add a thin translucent-white foam lace line along one wet-sand shoreline contour.
implementation_notes: Use a narrow additive ribbon with broken opacity, low intensity, and no large spray particles; keep it below the horizon and away from the main sky.
capture_safe_reason: The foam is a thin local additive accent that brightens the shoreline without turning the ocean into a white wash.
acceptance_test: Capture Ocean/Wide and verify the foam reads as a broken shoreline edge with restrained bloom and no pure-black ocean finals.

title: Wet sand reflective patches
change: Add three small warm-gray wet-sand sheen patches near the shoreline.
implementation_notes: Use flat unlit HF patches with muted tan-gray values, low contrast, and irregular small masks; avoid glossy PBR reflections and keep them local to the sand.
capture_safe_reason: The patches are restrained unlit HF detail, not dark PBR, and they add tonal continuity between foam and ocean.
acceptance_test: Verify Ocean retains visible water color, patches do not become mirror highlights, and the camera remains Usable.

title: Tide-pool glint dots
change: Add a sparse set of four tiny cyan-white glint proxies inside shallow tide pools.
implementation_notes: Use four fixed low-intensity points with varied size and opacity; disable animation and keep total screen coverage minimal.
capture_safe_reason: Fixed sparse emissive points provide controlled water detail without large foam or ocean luminance changes.
acceptance_test: Confirm glints remain pin-sized, do not twinkle or bloom excessively, and do not create black-to-white contrast collapse.

title: Submarine sail marker stripe
change: Add one narrow orange identification stripe to the visible submarine sail.
implementation_notes: Use a single subdued orange stripe on the sail, with brightness below a lamp and no additional submarine lights.
capture_safe_reason: One small additive color cue improves silhouette recognition while avoiding an all-black submarine read.
acceptance_test: Capture Ocean/Harbor and confirm stripe placement remains localized, non-glary, and does not obscure water separation.

title: Freighter bridge window band
change: Add a short pale-blue bridge-window band to the freighter superstructure.
implementation_notes: Use a single thin masked band with varied opacity and cool blue-white values; keep it below the intensity of navigation lighting.
capture_safe_reason: A narrow additive window band adds ship identity without introducing dark material or a large hero stack.
acceptance_test: Verify the band reads as windows at capture resolution, has no excessive bloom, and Harbor remains Usable.

title: Coast-block roof vent caps
change: Add two small light roof vent caps to a distant coast block.
implementation_notes: Place two compact bright vent caps behind wall at x>=bx+3; use painted concrete or pale plaster and keep them below the skyline focal line.
capture_safe_reason: Small bright rooftop accents add city scale without affecting the frozen foreground composition or exposure.
acceptance_test: Capture City/Wide and confirm both caps remain subtle, do not clip the skyline, and preserve 11/11 camera usability.

title: Glove-to-grip contact crescent
change: Add a thin cool-white emissive crescent exactly where the glove index finger presses into the rifle grip.
implementation_notes: Use a 2-3 px local-space proxy with restrained intensity; do not alter the rifle ADS HF checker or stripe material.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive contact cue preserves the existing unlit HF pattern and cannot introduce a dark FOV surface.
acceptance_test: ADS remains usable; HF checkers and stripes remain visible; contact crescent reads at capture distance without blooming.

title: Glove palm pressure plane
change: Add a tiny warm emissive pressure plane beneath the glove palm where it braces the rifle body.
implementation_notes: Keep the plane localized to the contact patch and below the highlight threshold; leave all base materials unchanged.
capture_safe_reason: The additive patch is small, localized, and does not replace any HF densify surface.
acceptance_test: Verify a readable palm-to-rifle contact point in ADS with no visible washout or HF checker loss.

title: Glove knuckle ridge cue
change: Place one narrow emissive ridge along the glove knuckle silhouette nearest the sight line.
implementation_notes: Use a broken, low-intensity line rather than a filled region so glove articulation remains visible.
capture_safe_reason: A broken edge-only proxy adds separation without creating a large bright or dark FOV mass.
acceptance_test: Knuckle contour is distinguishable in ADS; no clipping into the iron-sight aperture; HF pattern remains intact.

title: Grip wrap termination mark
change: Add a small amber unlit mark at the termination of the glove grip wrap near the trigger guard.
implementation_notes: Place the authored mark at x>=bx+3 so only a thin edge is visible; avoid a full glove texture replacement.
capture_safe_reason: The mark is a tiny behind-wall authored accent and leaves the ADS HF material untouched.
acceptance_test: Only the intended wrap termination mark peeks into ADS; no new dark region or silhouette obstruction appears.

title: Rear sight notch light cut
change: Add a hairline emissive cut along the rear iron-sight notch to clarify the sight picture.
implementation_notes: Constrain the line to the notch interior and keep intensity below a bloom response.
capture_safe_reason: Only the existing sight aperture receives a small additive cue; no HF background is covered.
acceptance_test: Rear notch is readable against the HF checker field while the field remains continuous around it.

title: Front sight post edge
change: Add a restrained vertical emissive edge to the front iron-sight post for alignment readability.
implementation_notes: Use a one-sided thin proxy on the post edge, not a filled bright post or replacement material.
capture_safe_reason: The cue is limited to an existing high-contrast sight edge and does not affect the HF checker or stripe surfaces.
acceptance_test: Front post aligns with the rear notch in ADS and remains legible without haloing.

title: Barrel bore rim
change: Add a thin neutral-blue emissive ring on the visible barrel bore rim to establish barrel direction.
implementation_notes: Use a partial ring following the existing rim; keep the center open and the intensity subtle.
capture_safe_reason: The open partial ring is a small additive proxy and cannot become a solid dark or bright FOV patch.
acceptance_test: Barrel axis reads in ADS; bore center remains open; no change to the HF densify pattern.

title: Barrel collar separation line
change: Add one thin warm-gray unlit separation line around the first visible barrel collar.
implementation_notes: Keep the line on the rear-facing collar edge at x>=bx+3; use a light unlit tone rather than dark metal.
capture_safe_reason: This is a tiny behind-wall light edge cue with no FOV-wide material replacement.
acceptance_test: Collar depth is readable in ADS and the line does not create a new black band or obscure the sight picture.

title: Igla tube identity stripe
change: Add a narrow two-tone emissive identity stripe along the visible Igla tube axis.
implementation_notes: Use muted cyan and amber segments with low intensity; preserve any existing HF checks beneath and around the stripe.
capture_safe_reason: The stripe is narrow, additive, and localized to the Igla proxy, so it cannot replace ADS HF densify.
acceptance_test: Igla tube is distinguishable from the rifle in ADS without stripe bloom or checker loss.

title: Igla seeker cap rim
change: Add a small emissive crescent around the visible Igla seeker-cap rim.
implementation_notes: Use only the upper third of the rim and leave the cap face unmodified.
capture_safe_reason: A partial rim cue adds silhouette information while leaving the HF field and cap interior unchanged.
acceptance_test: The seeker cap reads as a separate circular component at ADS scale with no new solid-dark disk.

title: Igla carry-handle contour
change: Add a slim pale emissive contour on the front-facing edge of the Igla carry handle.
implementation_notes: Follow the handle silhouette with a discontinuous line and keep the interior transparent.
capture_safe_reason: The discontinuous contour is additive and edge-only, with no broad FOV fill.
acceptance_test: Carry handle silhouette is readable behind the rifle without merging into the iron-sight cue.

title: Igla warning stencil fragment
change: Add a tiny high-contrast unlit stencil fragment on the Igla tube to establish scale and orientation.
implementation_notes: Place only a short two-symbol fragment at x>=bx+3; use a pale unlit color over the existing non-dark surface.
capture_safe_reason: The stencil is a tiny authored behind-wall accent and does not modify the HF densify material.
acceptance_test: At least one readable stencil fragment is visible in ADS without becoming UI-like or covering the HF pattern.

title: Igla fin leading edge
change: Add a narrow emissive leading-edge cue to the visible Igla stabilizer fin.
implementation_notes: Limit the cue to the outer leading edge and use a low-intensity neutral tone.
capture_safe_reason: The edge-only additive proxy improves fin separation without adding a broad dark or washed-out surface.
acceptance_test: Fin direction reads at ADS distance and remains separate from the rifle barrel silhouette.

title: Magazine release silhouette
change: Add a small light unlit silhouette accent to the rifle magazine-release lever.
implementation_notes: Expose only the lever tip from x>=bx+3; keep its backing surface unchanged.
capture_safe_reason: The tiny behind-wall lever tip adds a functional rifle cue without introducing a dark material block.
acceptance_test: Lever tip is identifiable in ADS and does not intersect the glove contact crescent.

title: Trigger-guard inner arc
change: Add a thin additive emissive arc on the inner trigger-guard edge nearest the glove.
implementation_notes: Use a partial arc only on the contact-facing side; avoid filling the guard opening.
capture_safe_reason: The partial arc is a small edge proxy and keeps the HF checker and stripe pattern visible through the guard opening.
acceptance_test: Guard opening remains open in ADS and the glove-to-guard relationship is readable without bloom.

title: Ejection-port edge cue
change: Add one short pale emissive segment along the rifle ejection-port lip.
implementation_notes: Constrain the segment to the rear lip and keep the port interior on the existing material.
capture_safe_reason: Only an existing mechanical edge is accented; the change cannot replace the ADS HF surface.
acceptance_test: Ejection port reads as a recessed feature in ADS with no dark rectangle or highlight washout.

title: Sling swivel glint
change: Add a tiny single-point emissive glint to the visible rifle sling swivel.
implementation_notes: Use a small circular proxy below the bloom threshold and place it away from the sight aperture.
capture_safe_reason: The glint is a single small additive point with negligible coverage and no material replacement.
acceptance_test: Swivel location is readable in ADS without competing with front or rear sight alignment.

title: Glove fingertip contact notch
change: Add a tiny warm emissive notch at the glove fingertip-to-receiver contact seam.
implementation_notes: Use a short curved segment only at the actual overlap seam; keep it thinner than the grip contact crescent.
capture_safe_reason: The seam is a localized additive contact cue that preserves all existing unlit HF detail.
acceptance_test: Fingertip contact reads as intentional in ADS and the seam does not merge into the sight or barrel cues.

title: Iron-sight alignment guide
change: Add a very thin intermittent emissive guide between the rear notch and front post to reinforce the ADS axis.
implementation_notes: Use three separated dashes with low intensity and stop before the sight aperture edges; never use a solid line.
capture_safe_reason: Intermittent, low-intensity dashes preserve the checker/stripe field and avoid a UI-like overlay.
acceptance_test: Sight axis reads immediately in ADS; all three dashes remain subtle and do not bloom or cover HF detail.

title: Barrel vent interior glints
change: Add two separated cool emissive glints inside the visible barrel vent openings.
implementation_notes: Place glints only in existing openings, keep the openings transparent, and use asymmetric placement for uniqueness.
capture_safe_reason: The accents occupy existing negative spaces and add no solid dark FOV material or HF replacement.
acceptance_test: Vent depth and barrel direction improve in ADS; openings remain distinct and the HF pattern is unchanged.

title: Directional muzzle flash petals
change: Add a three-petal additive muzzle flash burst with a forward-biased silhouette and 0.04 second lifetime.
implementation_notes: Use a very small cone-aligned proxy at the weapon bore, warm white center with restrained amber edges, one burst per shot, no opaque smoke geometry.
capture_safe_reason: Additive-only, sub-frame flash confined to the weapon bore and below the L55 silhouette envelope.
acceptance_test: PropNose and ADS remain Usable with a readable flash shape and no persistent dark pixels after the burst.

title: Muzzle flash radial pulse
change: Add a thin radial emissive pulse at the muzzle immediately after the primary flash.
implementation_notes: Use a 0.02 second expanding ring with low opacity, limited to the weapon silhouette, and disable bloom-heavy scaling.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive ring has no opaque coverage and does not alter background luminance.
acceptance_test: The ring reads as a single shot accent in ADS without washing out nearby geometry or creating a visible wall.

title: Thin gun smoke filament
change: Add one narrow dissipating smoke filament trailing upward from the weapon after firing.
implementation_notes: Use pale gray additive particles at very low opacity, three particles maximum, 0.35 second lifetime, and no camera-facing wall sprites.
capture_safe_reason: The effect is thin, translucent, and localized to the firing point; it cannot form a dark FOV wall.
acceptance_test: Smoke remains a narrow filament in both cameras and clears before the next capture frame.

title: Gun smoke curl breakup
change: Replace the final gun-smoke particle with two small upward-curling wisps that separate before fading.
implementation_notes: Use two low-alpha ribbons, 0.22 second lifetime, soft gray-blue tint, and a strict maximum screen-space width.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive wisps break up the shell without introducing opaque smoke coverage.
acceptance_test: No camera shows a dark smoke patch, and the wisps remain inside the weapon-adjacent silhouette.

title: Hit spark needle burst
change: Add a six-particle needle-shaped hit spark burst at confirmed impact points.
implementation_notes: Use short radial needles with warm-white cores, amber tips, 0.08 second lifetime, and bounded particle count.
capture_safe_reason: Only emissive needle geometry is added at local impact points; no dark or opaque coverage is introduced.
acceptance_test: Impacts read clearly at capture resolution while the surrounding material values remain unchanged.

title: Ricochet spark streak
change: Add one short directional ricochet streak leaving each metallic impact point.
implementation_notes: Orient the streak along the impact normal, use a 0.06 second lifetime, and clamp length to a few pixels in the final capture.
capture_safe_reason: A single tiny additive streak improves impact readability without affecting broad regions of either camera.
acceptance_test: The streak is visible only at impact locations and does not become a continuous line or screen-space artifact.

title: Drone explosion hot core
change: Add a compact additive hot-core flash inside the drone explosion volume.
implementation_notes: Use one small spherical proxy with a white-to-orange gradient, 0.12 second lifetime, and no opaque shell.
capture_safe_reason: The proxy is additive, compact, and isolated to the existing drone event location.
acceptance_test: The explosion gains a readable center without blooming over adjacent aircraft edges or sky.

title: Drone explosion shock ring
change: Add a thin expanding emissive shock ring around the drone explosion core.
implementation_notes: Use a single camera-facing ring with 0.16 second lifetime, low opacity, and a strict maximum radius tied to the drone bounds.
capture_safe_reason: The ring remains inside a small event footprint and contributes no opaque or dark material.
acceptance_test: Wide and Combat retain clear sky separation with a readable ring that fades before becoming a broad halo.

title: Flak pinprick cluster
change: Add three separated additive flak pinpricks around the existing burst center.
implementation_notes: Use tiny warm-white points with nonuniform spacing, 0.1 second lifetime, and no smoke sprite layer.
capture_safe_reason: Separated points preserve city and sky visibility while adding high-frequency event detail.
acceptance_test: City and Wide show distinct flak points without a connected dark mass or sky washout.

title: Flak micro-ring accent
change: Add a narrow low-alpha ring immediately around the flak burst center.
implementation_notes: Keep the ring radius below the existing burst bounds, use 0.08 second lifetime, and tint it neutral warm gray rather than saturated orange.
capture_safe_reason: The thin additive ring is local to the burst and does not obscure buildings, aircraft, or sky.
acceptance_test: The ring improves burst shape recognition without changing the broad luminance distribution of either camera.

title: Prop wash edge ribbons
change: Add two narrow additive ribbons along the outer edges of the prop wash volume.
implementation_notes: Use pale blue-white translucent ribbons with low opacity, 0.28 second lifetime, and placement outside the cockpit and fuselage centerline.
capture_safe_reason: Ribbons are additive, thin, and placed at the existing effect boundary rather than across the aircraft body.
acceptance_test: Prop and YakBeauty retain readable aircraft contours with a subtle directional wash cue.

title: Prop wash vortex dots
change: Add four small rotating emissive markers to suggest the prop wash vortex without adding opaque dust.
implementation_notes: Use four low-intensity dots arranged in a shallow arc, 0.18 second lifetime, with rotation constrained to the local propeller plane.
capture_safe_reason: Tiny emissive markers add motion structure while leaving the prop hub and aircraft shading unobstructed.
acceptance_test: Markers remain individually separated and do not merge into a bright disc in either camera.

title: Tracer segmented streak
change: Add a two-segment additive tracer streak with a deliberate gap between lead and tail.
implementation_notes: Use two short segments aligned to projectile travel, 0.11 second lifetime, with the tail at half intensity and no continuous beam.
capture_safe_reason: The tracer is narrow and additive, with bounded length that cannot form a bright FOV band.
acceptance_test: Combat and ADS show projectile direction clearly without clipping across unrelated geometry.

title: Tracer launch spark
change: Add a single small launch spark at the tracer origin before the streak appears.
implementation_notes: Use one pin-sized flash with 0.035 second lifetime, warm-white center, and strict origin anchoring to the emitter.
capture_safe_reason: A single origin-local additive point has negligible screen coverage and no material replacement.
acceptance_test: The launch cue is visible at the emitter without producing a persistent bright dot in later frames.

title: Ocean spray bead chain
change: Add a short chain of four bright spray beads along the crest of the existing ocean impact.
implementation_notes: Use tiny pale-blue additive spheres with varied height, 0.2 second lifetime, and no broad spray fan geometry.
capture_safe_reason: Beads are sparse, small, and additive, preserving the L55 ocean silhouette and avoiding a duplicated broad fan.
acceptance_test: Ocean and Harbor gain readable water breakup without a continuous bright strip or dark patch.

title: Water splash crown tips
change: Add five tiny additive crown tips at the outer edge of a water splash impact.
implementation_notes: Use a low-opacity pale foam tint, 0.14 second lifetime, and keep all tips inside the existing splash footprint.
capture_safe_reason: Only small additive tips are introduced, with no change to ocean materials or large silhouette coverage.
acceptance_test: Splash edges become legible at capture resolution while horizon and water values remain stable.

title: Missile trail knot accents
change: Add two separated hot knots along the missile trail at fixed intervals.
implementation_notes: Use small orange-white additive knots with 0.12 second lifetime and low intensity, excluding any opaque smoke volume.
capture_safe_reason: Knots are sparse emissive accents along an existing line and cannot create a dark trail wall.
acceptance_test: The trail reads as directional and continuous without becoming a bright diagonal across the full frame.

title: Behind-wall missile trail breakup
change: Place three tiny pale trail breakup puffs behind the primary wall boundary to add depth to the missile path.
implementation_notes: Keep all geometry at x>=bx+3, use small unlit pale-blue sprites with short lifetimes, and omit dark smoke coloration.
capture_safe_reason: Hero-authored geometry is explicitly behind the wall boundary and uses pale unlit values rather than dark smoke.
acceptance_test: Depth breakup is visible only in the intended background region and leaves foreground silhouettes unchanged.

title: Explosion falling spark flecks
change: Add three short-lived non-ember white-orange flecks descending from the drone explosion edge.
implementation_notes: Use angular debris-like flecks rather than round embers, 0.13 second lifetime, low count, and strict local bounds around the explosion.
capture_safe_reason: The flecks are sparse additive particles and are distinct from the existing ember accent.
acceptance_test: Flecks add a downward breakup cue without becoming a repeated ember field or affecting harbor readability.

title: Localized flak impact glint
change: Add one thin emissive glint line at the nearest flak impact edge to sharpen the burst silhouette.
implementation_notes: Use a single sub-burst line aligned to the local impact normal, 0.05 second lifetime, and cap length below the existing flak radius.
capture_safe_reason: A single tiny additive line provides local edge definition without changing city or prop-hub materials.
acceptance_test: The nearest flak event gains one readable edge highlight while all 11 cameras remain Usable.
